examples.chinese: 我想買兩本中文書、一本英文書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, yì běn Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: I want to buy two books in Chinese and a book in English.

examples.chinese: 友美愛看書，我想送她兩本中文書，你呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi ài kànshū, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, nǐ ne?
examples.english: Youmei loves reading. I would like to give her two books in Chinese as a gift. How about you?

examples.chinese: 我有兩枝鉛筆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī qiānbǐ.
examples.english: I have two pencils.

examples.chinese: 我們買兩枝，好不好？兩枝五十塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi liǎng zhī, hǎo bù hǎo? Liǎng zhī wǔshí kuài qián.
examples.english: How about we buy two of them? Two for 50NT dollars.

examples.chinese: 我有一位英國老師和兩位日本老師。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí wèi Yīngguó lǎoshī hé liǎng wèi Rìběn lǎoshī.
examples.english: I have one British teacher and two Japanese teachers.

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共兩萬三千五百零五塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng liǎng wàn sān qiān wǔ bǎi líng wǔ kuài.
examples.english: These stuff cost twenty three thousand, five hundred and five dollars in total.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽有一個哥哥跟兩個妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǒu yí ge gēge gēn liǎng ge mèimei.
examples.english: My mom has an elder brother and two younger sisters.

examples.chinese: 客廳裡面有兩張沙發。
examples.pinyin: Kètīng lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng zhāng shāfā.
examples.english: There are two sofas in the living room.

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.chinese: 小姐，我們要點兩碗牛肉麵和兩杯茶。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒmen yào diǎn liǎng wǎn niúròu miàn hé liǎng bēi chá.
examples.english: Miss, we would like to order two bowls of beef noodles and two cups of tea.

examples.chinese: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
examples.english: Would you like to have black tea or green tea?

examples.chinese: 一共兩百一十五塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Yígòng liǎng bǎi yīshíwǔ kuài qián.
examples.english: It will be 215 dollars in total.

examples.chinese: 一共兩百多塊錢，好便宜！
examples.pinyin: Yígòng liǎng bǎi duō kuài qián, hǎo piányi!
examples.english: It is only a little over 200. It is cheap!

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 這兩天天氣有點兒冷，我們週末去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, wǒmen zhōumò qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is a bit cold those two days. How about we do it this weekend?

examples.chinese: 這兩條我都去穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo wǒ dōu qù chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: I will try both on.

items.wordHook: a 一(one) 巾(cloth) hides an 入(tucked) upside-down person → 兩(two).

examples.chinese: 我們可以去問家樂，他非常聰明，我想他懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ qù wèn Jiālè, tā fēicháng cōngmíng, wǒ xiǎng tā dǒng.
examples.english: We can ask Jiale; he is very smart. I think he understands it.

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

examples.chinese: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧，我照了很多相片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dài zhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào, wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: Last year I went to see the Carnival. Many adults brought their children to see the Lantern Carnival, and it was very lively. I took a lot of photos.

items.wordHook: 非(not) + 常(common) → not common, so 'very' (extraordinary).

examples.chinese: 走路跟騎腳踏車的時候，我們都要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zǒulù gēn qí jiǎotàchē de shíhòu, wǒmen dōu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: When walking and riding a bicycle, we all need to be careful.

examples.chinese: 他因為打籃球的時候不小心，所以手受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi dǎ lánqiú de shíhòu bù xiǎoxīn, suǒyǐ shǒu shòushāng le.
examples.english: Because he was not careful when playing basketball, his hand got injured.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，我不小心拿了你的書？ B:原來書在你這裡，我剛才在教室裡找了好久。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn ná le nǐ de shū? B: Yuánlái shū zài nǐ zhèlǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ.
examples.english: A: Sorry, I accidentally took your book? B: It turns out the book is here with you; I was looking in the classroom for a long time just now.

examples.chinese: 上樓、下樓的時候都不要急，小心走。
examples.pinyin: Shàng lóu, xià lóu de shíhòu dōu bùyào jí, xiǎoxīn zǒu.
examples.english: When going upstairs or downstairs, don't be in a hurry; walk carefully.

examples.chinese: 你不要亂吃東西，小心肚子疼！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùyào luàn chī dōngxi, xiǎoxīn dùzi téng!
examples.english: Don't eat things randomly; be careful of a stomachache!

examples.chinese: 我去義大利旅行的時候，不小心把護照弄丟了，我擔心死了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yìdàlì lǚxíng de shíhou, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ hùzhào nòngdiū le, wǒ dānxīn sǐ le.
examples.english: When I was traveling in Italy, I accidentally lost my passport; I was worried to death.

examples.chinese: 在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。
examples.pinyin: Zài shānshàng kǎoròu shí yào fēicháng zhùyì, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù kěnéng yǐnqǐ sēnlín huǒzāi.
examples.english: When having a barbecue in the mountains, you must be very careful; if you are not careful, it may cause a forest fire.

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 外面下著大雨，路很滑，請小心開車。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià zhe dàyǔ, lù hěn huá, qǐng xiǎoxīn kāichē.
examples.english: It's raining heavily outside, the road is very slippery, please drive carefully.

examples.chinese: 你上班別遲到，小心公司扣你的錢！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shàngbān bié chídào, xiǎoxīn gōngsī kòu nǐ de qián!
examples.english: Don't be late for work; be careful the company might dock your pay!

examples.chinese: 這座橋對車子的高度有限制，開大車的人要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo duì chēzi de gāodù yǒu xiànzhì, kāi dàchē de rén yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This bridge has a height restriction for vehicles; those driving large vehicles should be careful.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 火鍋(hotpot)剛煮好時很燙，吃的時候小心點兒。
examples.pinyin: Huǒguō gāng zhǔ hǎo shí hěn tàng, chī de shíhou xiǎoxīn diǎnr.
examples.english: Hotpot is scalding hot when it's just cooked, so be careful when eating it.

examples.chinese: 這種植物的葉子尖尖的，流出來的汁又臭又黏，觀察時要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de yèzi jiān jiān de, liú chūlái de zhī yòu chòu yòu nián, guānchá shí yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: The leaves of this plant are pointy, and the sap that flows out is both smelly and sticky; be careful when observing it.

examples.chinese: 在瀑布旁邊照相要看看周圍環境，別不小心掉下去了。
examples.pinyin: Zài pùbù pángbiān zhàoxiàng yào kànkan zhōuwéi huánjìng, bié bù xiǎoxīn diào xiàqù le.
examples.english: When taking photos next to a waterfall, you should look at the surrounding environment; don't accidentally fall down.

examples.chinese: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì rènwu jiàoxùn hòu, Xiǎo Zhōu zuòshì jiù biàn de gèngjiā xiǎoxīn le.
examples.english: After the lesson from that mission, Xiao Zhou became even more careful in doing things.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩跑得太快，一不小心就跌倒了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái pǎo de tài kuài, yībùxiǎoxīn jiù diēdǎo le.
examples.english: That child ran too fast and accidentally fell down.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有不小心發生錯誤的時候，不需要取笑別人。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng cuòwù de shíhou, bù xūyào qǔxiào biérén.
examples.english: Everyone has times when they accidentally make mistakes; there is no need to make fun of others.

examples.chinese: 史小姐到花蓮來觀光時不小心迷了路，幸虧遇到了熱心的阿姨送她回旅館。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě dào Huālián lái guānguāng shí bù xiǎoxīn mí le lù, xìngkuī yùdào le rèxīn de āyí sòng tā huí lǚguǎn.
examples.english: When Miss Shi came to Hualien for sightseeing, she accidentally got lost; fortunately, she met a warmhearted auntie who took her back to the hotel.

examples.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

items.wordHook: 小心 means careful: keep a small (小) heart (心) → cautious and alert.

examples.chinese: 中明，你手裡拿著什麼？
examples.pinyin: Zhōngmíng, nǐ shǒu lǐ ná zhe shénme?
examples.english: Zhongming, what you are holding in your hand?

examples.chinese: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧，我照了很多相片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dài zhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào, wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: Last year I went to see the Carnival. Many adults brought their children to see the Lantern Carnival, and it was very lively. I took a lot of photos.

items.wordHook: a 艹(grass) grows over 者(those who) wait → 著(particle).

examples.chinese: A:這些相片是在哪裡照的？ B:花蓮。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē xiàngpiàn shì zài nǎlǐ zhào de? B: Huālián.
examples.english: A: Where were these photos taken? B: Hualien.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾包花蓮當地的名產，要送給台北的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le jǐ bāo Huālián dāngdì de míngchǎn, yào sòng gěi Táiběi de péngyou.
examples.english: I bought several packs of Hualien's local specialties to give to my friends in Taipei.

examples.chinese: 週末到花蓮的火車票一下子就賣光了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò dào Huālián de huǒchēpiào yīxiàzi jiù mài guāng le.
examples.english: Weekend train tickets to Hualien sold out in an instant.

examples.chinese: 這班車早上七點從台北出發，只停了三個站就到花蓮了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān chē zǎoshang qī diǎn cóng Táiběi chūfā, zhǐ tíng le sān ge zhàn jiù dào Huālián le.
examples.english: This train departs from Taipei at 7 a.m.; it stops at only three stations and then arrives in Hualien.

examples.chinese: 花蓮的風景很美，我想多留兩天，慢慢地看。
examples.pinyin: Huālián de fēngjǐng hěn měi, wǒ xiǎng duō liú liǎng tiān, mànmàn de kàn.
examples.english: Hualien's scenery is beautiful; I want to stay two more days and look around slowly.

examples.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
examples.pinyin: Huālián nà jǐ jiā lǚguǎn de shuāngrén kèfáng dōu kèmǎn le, wǒmen háishì dìng mínsù ba.
examples.english: The double guest rooms at those hotels in Hualien are all fully booked; we'd better book a homestay instead.

examples.chinese: 花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
examples.pinyin: Huālián Tàilǔgé dequè hěn piàoliang, nánguài měinián dōu xīyǐn xǔduō guānguāngkè qù cānguān.
examples.english: Hualien's Taroko Gorge is indeed very beautiful; no wonder it attracts many tourists to visit every year.

examples.chinese: 史小姐到花蓮來觀光時不小心迷了路，幸虧遇到了熱心的阿姨送她回旅館。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě dào Huālián lái guānguāng shí bù xiǎoxīn mí le lù, xìngkuī yùdào le rèxīn de āyí sòng tā huí lǚguǎn.
examples.english: When Miss Shi came to Hualien for sightseeing, she accidentally got lost; fortunately, she met a warmhearted auntie who took her back to the hotel.

items.wordHook: 花蓮 Hualien: picture a flower (花) and a lotus (蓮) blooming on Taiwan's east coast.

examples.chinese: 這個房子的房租不包括水費、電費。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángzi de fángzū bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi.
examples.english: The rent for this house does not include the water fee and electricity fee.

examples.chinese: 我的房租每個月一萬塊，加上水費、電費，差不多一萬三。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángzū měi gè yuè yī wàn kuài, jiāshàng shuǐfèi, diànfèi, chàbuduō yī wàn sān.
examples.english: My rent is 10,000 dollars a month; plus water and electricity fees, it's about 13,000.

examples.chinese: 這個月底我就可以學完這本書了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge yuèdǐ wǒ jiù kěyǐ xuéwán zhè běn shū le.
examples.english: By the end of this month, I will have finished studying this book.

examples.chinese: 你剛剛說要吃漢堡，現在說要吃炸雞，到底要吃什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gānggāng shuō yào chī hànbǎo, xiànzài shuō yào chī zhàjī, dàodǐ yào chī shénme?
examples.english: You just said you wanted to eat a hamburger, and now you say you want to eat fried chicken—what on earth do you want to eat?

examples.chinese: 到底哪一種冰淇淋最好吃，得看個人的口味。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ nǎ yì zhǒng bīngqílín zuì hǎochī, děi kàn gèrén de kǒuwèi.
examples.english: Which kind of ice cream is the most delicious ultimately depends on individual taste.

examples.chinese: 到底哪一種冰淇淋最好吃，得看個人的口味。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ nǎ yì zhǒng bīngqílín zuì hǎochī, děi kàn gèrén de kǒuwèi.
examples.english: Which kind of ice cream is the most delicious ultimately depends on individual taste.

examples.chinese: 臺灣是一個海島國家，周圍的海底有豐富的珍貴資源。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì yī gè hǎidǎo guójiā, zhōuwéi de hǎidǐ yǒu fēngfù de zhēnguì zīyuán.
examples.english: Taiwan is an island country; the seabed around it has rich and precious resources.

examples.chinese: 因為天氣太熱了，有一隻貓在車子底下休息，不肯離開。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì tài rè le, yǒu yì zhī māo zài chēzi dǐxià xiūxi, bù kěn líkāi.
examples.english: Because the weather is too hot, a cat is resting under the car and refuses to leave.

examples.chinese: 地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有夢想，只要不怕挑戰、堅持到底，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu mèngxiǎng, zhǐyào bú pà tiǎozhàn, jiānchí dàodǐ, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: Everyone has dreams; as long as you are not afraid of challenges and persist to the end, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 我知道那輛德國汽車很貴，至於到底多貴，我就不清楚了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nà liàng Déguó qìchē hěn guì, zhìyú dàodǐ duō guì, wǒ jiù bù qīngchu le.
examples.english: I know that German car is very expensive; as to exactly how expensive, I'm not clear.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiédǐ kuàiyào diào xiàlái le, děi qù diànlǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐlái. Tā bùguǎn wǒ máng bù máng, lǎoshì niánzhe wǒ liáotiān, ràng wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn fán. Xiàtiān de shíhou róngyì liúhàn, ràng yīfu biànde niánnián de, zhēn bù shūfu.
examples.english: My shoe sole is about to fall off; I need to go to the shop and ask someone to glue it back on. Regardless of whether I'm busy or not, he's always clinging to me to chat, which makes me feel a bit annoyed. In summer, it's easy to sweat, making clothes sticky, which is really uncomfortable.

items.wordHook: Under a wide 广(broad) roof reaching the lowest foundation: 底(bottom).

examples.chinese: 老師的要求很多，要寫五篇報告、三篇作文，怎麼寫得完？
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de yāoqiú hěn duō, yào xiě wǔ piān bàogào, sān piān zuòwén, zěnme xiě de wán?
examples.english: The teacher's requirements are many: write five reports and three essays—how can one finish writing them?

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
examples.pinyin: Dānrèn zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhēn bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ zhěnggè bùmén de yuángōng, hái yào dáchéng lǎobǎn de gōngzuò yāoqiú.
examples.english: Serving as a supervisor at this company is really not easy; not only do you have to manage the employees of the entire department, you also have to fulfill the boss's work requirements.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 這家公司雖然要求員工得穿西裝上班，但費用全是公司負擔的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán yāoqiú yuángōng děi chuān xīzhuāng shàngbān, dàn fèiyòng quán shì gōngsī fùdān de.
examples.english: Although this company requires employees to wear suits to work, the cost is entirely borne by the company.

examples.chinese: 七歲以下的孩子對手部動作還無法完全地掌握，因此不應要求他們正確地握筆。
examples.pinyin: Qī suì yǐxià de háizi duì shǒubù dòngzuò hái wúfǎ wánquán de zhǎngwò, yīncǐ bù yīng yāoqiú tāmen zhèngquè de wò bǐ.
examples.english: Children under seven years old still cannot fully master hand movements, so they should not be required to hold a pen correctly.

examples.chinese: 公司上頭要求小張一個人完成任務，同事們都認為有點兒勉強。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī shàngtóu yāoqiú Xiǎo Zhāng yī gè rén wánchéng rènwu, tóngshìmen dōu rènwéi yǒudiǎnr miǎnqiǎng.
examples.english: The company higher-ups asked Xiao Zhang to complete the task alone; his colleagues all thought it was a bit of a stretch.

examples.chinese: 部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Bùfèn dàxué kēxì duì xuéshēng chéngjì de yāoqiú fēicháng gāo, bìyè tiáojiàn yě jiào yángé.
examples.english: Some university departments have very high requirements for student grades, and graduation conditions are also stricter.

examples.chinese: 開會前經理要求大家勿開手機，專心討論會議內容。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì qián jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā wù kāi shǒujī, zhuānxīn tǎolùn huìyì nèiróng.
examples.english: Before the meeting, the manager asked everyone not to turn on their cell phones and to focus on discussing the meeting content.

examples.chinese: 父母要求孩子不論在任何情況都不許騙人。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yāoqiú háizi bùlùn zài rènhé qíngkuàng dōu bùxǔ piàn rén.
examples.english: Parents require that their children must not lie under any circumstances.

examples.chinese: 這次的說話比賽要求參加的學生說一個神奇的外國故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuōhuà bǐsài yāoqiú cānjiā de xuéshēng shuō yī gè shénqí de wàiguó gùshì.
examples.english: This speech contest requires participating students to tell a magical foreign story.

items.wordHook: Combining 要(essential) and 求(beg): 要求 means require, to demand.

items.key: ["B2L14-1-37","年年有余","年年有餘","年年有余","Ph"]
["B2L15-2-28","做人做事","做人做事","做人做事","Ph"]

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìjìng shì ge xiǎoháizi, hái bù dǒng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, děng tā zhǎngdà jiù huì míngbai le.
examples.english: After all, he is a child and doesn't yet understand the principles of how to conduct himself and do things; when he grows up, he will understand.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 這班學生多數都會說法國話，其中有半數是從歐洲來的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān xuéshēng duōshù dōu huì shuō Fǎguóhuà, qízhōng yǒu bànshù shì cóng Ōuzhōu lái de.
examples.english: Most of the students in this class can speak French; half of them are from Europe.

examples.chinese: 根據華人民間的說法，過年時如果收到紅包，整年就會有好運氣。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Huárén mínjiān de shuōfǎ, guònián shí rúguǒ shōudào hóngbāo, zhěng nián jiù huì yǒu hǎoyùnqi.
examples.english: According to Chinese folk sayings, if you receive a red envelope during the New Year, you will have good luck for the whole year.

items.wordHook: Combining 說(speak) and 法(law): 說法 means version.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 太好了！我最愛吃牛肉麵。他們也賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zuì ài chī niúròu miàn. Tāmen yě mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: That is awesome! Beef noodles is my favorite. Do they sell drinks as well?

items.wordHook: 好(good) + 了(change) → now good, so getting well.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
examples.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
examples.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

examples.chinese: 你的才能符合我們公司的條件，是我們需要的人才。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de cáinéng fúhé wǒmen gōngsī de tiáojiàn, shì wǒmen xūyào de réncái.
examples.english: Your talent matches our company's requirements; you are the talent we need.

items.wordHook: Combining 符(amulet) and 合(combine): 符合 means be up to, to be in accord with.

examples.chinese: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
examples.english: In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him.

items.wordHook: Combining 同(same) and 情(feeling): 同情 means sympathize with, to feel pity for.

examples.chinese: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.
examples.english: Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 儘管他沒主持過什麼節目，他的獨特風格仍然引起大家注意。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā méi zhǔchí guò shénme jiémù, tā de dútè fēnggé réngrán yǐnqǐ dàjiā zhùyì.
examples.english: Although he has never hosted any programs, his unique style still attracted everyone's attention.

items.wordHook: Combining 儘(exhaust) and 管(manage): 儘管 means even though, in spite of.
Combining 帳(tent) and 號(mark): 帳號 means account.

examples.chinese: 這個山區種了許多茶樹，到了收穫季節，就會有一群採茶姑娘上山採茶。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shānqū zhòng le xǔduō cháshù, dào le shōuhuò jìjié, jiù huì yǒu yī qún cǎi chá gūniang shàngshān cǎi chá.
examples.english: Many tea trees are planted in this mountainous area; when the harvest season comes, a group of tea-picking girls will go up the mountain to pick tea.

items.wordHook: Combining 姑(father's sister) and 娘(mother): 姑娘 means girl.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

items.wordHook: Having 沒(gone) critical 話(talk) left to 說(speak): 沒話說 means beyond words.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 這面牆壁上的圖畫真美，是誰畫的？
examples.pinyin: Zhè miàn qiángbì shàng de túhuà zhēn měi, shì shéi huà de?
examples.english: The picture on this wall is really beautiful—who painted it?

examples.chinese: 這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú shèjì tú huà de hěn zǐxì, huà tú de rén yīnggāi xiāngdāng xìxīn.
examples.english: This design drawing is drawn very carefully; the person who drew it must be quite meticulous.

items.wordHook: Combining 圖(picture) and 畫(picture): 圖畫 means picture, illustration.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

examples.chinese: 小孩子剛學習用筷子吃麵條時，常需要媽媽先替他把麵拌一拌。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi gāng xuéxí yòng kuàizi chī miàntiáo shí, cháng xūyào māma xiān tì tā bǎ miàn bàn yī bàn.
examples.english: When little children first learn to eat noodles with chopsticks, they often need their mother to first mix the noodles for them.

items.wordHook: Long strips of kneaded 麵(face) dough sliced into a 條(strip): 麵條 means noodles.

examples.chinese: 危險物品必須放在小朋友伸手拿不到的地方。
examples.pinyin: Wēixiǎn wùpǐn bìxū fàng zài xiǎopéngyǒu shēnshǒu ná bù dào de dìfāng.
examples.english: Dangerous items must be placed in a place where children cannot reach out and get them.

examples.chinese: 我的家鄉出產小麥、葡萄，可是不產茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiāxiāng chūchǎn xiǎomài, pútao, kěshì bù chǎn chá.
examples.english: My hometown produces wheat and grapes, but it does not produce tea.

examples.chinese: 我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā chūkǒu de nóngchǎnpǐn hěn yǒumíng, bùdàn jiàgé dī, pǐnzhì yòu hǎo.
examples.english: The agricultural products our country exports are very famous; not only is the price low, but the quality is also good.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ tiáojiàn hǎo de dìqū, bùdàn nóngchǎnpǐn zhǒnglèi jiào duō, jiàgé yě piányi.
examples.english: In areas with good geographical conditions, not only are there more types of agricultural produce, but the prices are also cheaper.

examples.chinese: 這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì cháhuì zhǔyào shì wèile zhāodài kèhù, tóngshí tòuguò zhège cháhuì lái fābiǎo gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This tea party is mainly to entertain clients, and at the same time, through this tea party, to launch the company's new products.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo. Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english: Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags. On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 公司的生產部門這個月規劃了員工旅遊，有三個不同地點讓大家選擇。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de shēngchǎn bùmén zhège yuè guīhuà le yuángōng lǚyóu, yǒu sān ge bùtóng dìdiǎn ràng dàjiā xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The company's production department planned an employee trip this month, with three different locations for everyone to choose from.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn de píxié, pídài, bùdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The leather shoes and belts that that factory produces are not only good in quality, but also not expensive in price.

examples.chinese: 來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！
examples.pinyin: Lái lái lái, kuài lái mǎi! Wǒmen 3C chǎnpǐn de jiàgé zuì yōuhuì, pǐnzhì yě hěn hǎo, kuài bǎwò jīhuì o!
examples.english: Come, come, come, hurry and buy! Our 3C products have the most favorable prices and very good quality—grab the opportunity!

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 電腦、手機、平板等等，都是3C產品。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo, shǒujī, píngbǎn děngděng, dōu shì 3C chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Computers, cell phones, tablets, and so on are all 3C products.

examples.chinese: 請你說明一下，這些產品的功能有什麼差別？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuōmíng yíxià, zhèxiē chǎnpǐn de gōngnéng yǒu shénme chābié?
examples.english: Please explain, what differences are there in the functions of these products?

examples.chinese: 我買了幾包花蓮當地的名產，要送給台北的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le jǐ bāo Huālián dāngdì de míngchǎn, yào sòng gěi Táiběi de péngyou.
examples.english: I bought several packs of Hualien's local specialties to give to my friends in Taipei.

examples.chinese: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi huódòng chǎnshēng xǔduō lājī, bùdàn wūrǎn le huánjìng, gèng gǎibiàn le quánqiú qìhòu.
examples.english: Human activities produce a lot of garbage, which not only polluted the environment but also changed the global climate.

examples.chinese: 汽車的汽油燃燒不完全的話，容易產生很多廢氣。
examples.pinyin: Qìchē de qìyóu ránshāo bù wánquán de huà, róngyì chǎnshēng hěn duō fèiqì.
examples.english: If a car's gasoline does not burn completely, it easily produces a lot of exhaust fumes.

examples.chinese: 過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Guòdù xiāofèi jí shǐyòng sùjiāo cáiliào de chǎnpǐn, dōu huì zēngjiā zìrán huánjìng de fùdān.
examples.english: Excessive consumption and the use of plastic material products will both increase the burden on the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjìtú nǐ yī gè rén fùzé tài xīnkǔ le, dào bùrú zhǎo tóngshì yīqǐ lái zuò.
examples.english: It's too hard for you to be responsible for that new product's design drawings all by yourself; it would be better to find colleagues to do it together.

examples.chinese: 經理對新產品計畫的指示不太清楚，我們最好去問清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ duì xīn chǎnpǐn jìhuà de zhǐshì bù tài qīngchu, wǒmen zuì hǎo qù wèn qīngchu.
examples.english: The manager's instructions about the new product plan are not very clear; we'd better go ask and clarify.

examples.chinese: 那個農村裡有個小農場，他們生產的鮮奶冰淇淋非常好吃。
examples.pinyin: Nàge nóngcūn lǐ yǒu ge xiǎo nóngchǎng, tāmen shēngchǎn de xiānnǎi bīngqílín fēicháng hǎochī.
examples.english: In that village there is a small farm; the fresh milk ice cream they produce is very delicious.

examples.chinese: 哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
examples.pinyin: Āiyō, yǐjīng bànyè yìdiǎn duō le! Wǒmen jiù bié zài jiābān xiě chǎnpǐn jìhuà le, děng míngtiān zài jìxù ba!
examples.english: Woah, it's already past one in the morning! Let's stop working overtime to write the product plan, and continue tomorrow!

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ kèhù ānxīn shǐyòng, wǒmen gōngsī chǎnpǐn dìng le yángé de shēngchǎn biāozhǔn.
examples.english: In order to let customers use them with peace of mind, our company has set strict production standards for its products.

examples.chinese: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
examples.pinyin: Wèile rénmín de jiànkāng, xǔduō guójiā dōu jìnzhǐ jìnkǒu shòudào huánjìng wūrǎn de nóngchǎnpǐn.
examples.english: For the health of the people, many countries prohibit the import of agricultural products that have been polluted by the environment.

examples.chinese: 鑽石因為無法大量出產，所以才變得珍貴。
examples.pinyin: Zuànshí yīnwèi wúfǎ dàliàng chūchǎn, suǒyǐ cái biàn de zhēnguì.
examples.english: Because diamonds cannot be produced in large quantities, they have become precious.

examples.chinese: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bùduàn tuīxiāo xīnxíng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn, tōngcháng shì wèile cìjī kèhù gòumǎi.
examples.english: Companies constantly promote new types of electronic products, usually in order to stimulate customers to buy.

examples.chinese: 手機廠商時常邀請明星替他們的產品宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī chǎngshāng shícháng yāoqǐng míngxīng tì tāmen de chǎnpǐn xuānchuán.
examples.english: Mobile phone manufacturers often invite celebrities to promote their products.

examples.chinese: 水和冰基本上是相同的，只是因溫度而產生不同的變化。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ hé bīng jīběnshàng shì xiāngtóng de, zhǐshì yīn wēndù ér chǎnshēng bùtóng de biànhuà.
examples.english: Water and ice are basically the same; they just undergo different changes due to temperature.

examples.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
examples.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
examples.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

examples.chinese: 這輛車雖然是從美國進口，但零件卻是在越南生產的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē suīrán shì cóng Měiguó jìnkǒu, dàn língjiàn què shì zài Yuènán shēngchǎn de.
examples.english: Although this car is imported from the US, its parts are actually produced in Vietnam.

examples.chinese: 根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàng zīliào, zhège táifēng wèilái liǎng tiān huì wǎng xī yídòng, zhōuwǔ qǐ duì Táiwān chǎnshēng yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: According to meteorological data, this typhoon will move westward over the next two days and will begin to affect Taiwan from Friday.

examples.chinese: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ chǎnyè fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shòudào hěn shēn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: With the development of the electronics industry, people's living habits have also been deeply affected.

examples.chinese: 自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng cǎiyòng zhuānjiā tígōng de fāngfǎ hòu, cháyè de chǎnliàng yǐ zēngjiā bǎifēnzhī wǔshí.
examples.english: Since adopting the method provided by experts, the production output of tea leaves has increased by 50 percent.

examples.chinese: 當森林漸漸從地球上消失時，可能使全球氣候產生重大的變化。
examples.pinyin: Dāng sēnlín jiànjiàn cóng dìqiú shàng xiāoshī shí, kěnéng shǐ quánqiú qìhòu chǎnshēng zhòngdà de biànhuà.
examples.english: When forests gradually disappear from the Earth, it may cause major changes in the global climate.

examples.chinese: 使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng gāodù jìshù zhìzào chūlái de gōngyè shēngchǎn jīqì, cāozuò qǐlái wǎngwǎng gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Industrial production machines manufactured using highly advanced technology often operate more efficiently.

examples.chinese: 這家廠商針對老年人的需求生產了一種新奶粉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chǎngshāng zhēnduì lǎoniánrén de xūqiú shēngchǎn le yī zhǒng xīn nǎifěn.
examples.english: This manufacturer, targeting the needs of the elderly, has produced a new kind of powdered milk.

examples.chinese: 我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài zhè cì diànzǐ zhǎn gòng fābiǎo le jiǔ xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn, bìng xīyǐn bù shǎo guówài kèhù lái cānguān.
examples.english: Our company altogether launched nine new products at this electronics exhibition, and attracted many foreign clients to visit.

examples.chinese: 他對發展新科技向來保守，不願接受人工智慧產品。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì fāzhǎn xīn kējì xiànglái bǎoshǒu, bù yuàn jiēshòu réngōng zhìhuì chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: He has always been conservative about developing new technology and is unwilling to accept artificial intelligence products.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng duó xià le zhùmíng pǐnpái chǎnpǐn de zhìzào jīhuì.
examples.english: This factory seized the manufacturing opportunity for a famous brand's products.

examples.chinese: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué zhǒngzú zhījiān yīn wénhuà chāyì chǎnshēng de wèntí, zuì hǎo de bànfǎ jiùshì hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
examples.english: To solve problems that arise between races due to cultural differences, the best approach is mutual respect.

examples.chinese: 我每天騎車上班前，總是習慣先檢查摩托車的輪子正不正常。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān qí chē shàngbān qián, zǒngshì xíguàn xiān jiǎnchá mótuōchē de lúnzi zhèng bù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Before I ride my bike to work every day, I always habitually first check whether the motorcycle's tires are normal.

examples.chinese: 這輛卡車有十二個輪子，大約能載二十五噸的物品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē yǒu shí'èr ge lúnzi, dàyuē néng zài èrshíwǔ dūn de wùpǐn.
examples.english: This truck has twelve wheels and can carry about twenty-five tons of goods.

examples.chinese: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de lìliàng, jīngguò le shí nián, zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège fāmíng.
examples.english: Relying on his own strength, after ten years, he finally completed this invention.

examples.chinese: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè guójiā guāng shì yīkào miǎnfèi qiānzhèng, shì wúfǎ xīyǐn guówài yóukè lái lǚxíng de.
examples.english: A country solely relying on free visas is unable to attract foreign tourists to travel.

examples.chinese: 寄掛號信雖然貴了一點兒，可是比較可靠。
examples.pinyin: Jì guàhàoxìn suīrán guì le yīdiǎnr, kěshì bǐjiào kěkào.
examples.english: Although sending a registered letter is a bit more expensive, it is more reliable.

examples.chinese: 如果看不清楚黑板上的字，你可以靠近一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ kàn bù qīngchǔ hēibǎn shàng de zì, nǐ kěyǐ kàojìn yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: If you can't see the words on the blackboard clearly, you can move a bit closer.

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese: 電視臺常在熱門比賽的轉播中放一些廣告，靠這種方式來賺錢。
examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái cháng zài rèmén bǐsài de zhuǎnbō zhōng fàng yīxiē guǎnggào, kào zhè zhǒng fāngshì lái zhuànqián.
examples.english: TV stations often place some advertisements during the broadcast of popular matches, relying on this method to make money.

examples.chinese: 雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
examples.pinyin: Diāokè yùqì de jìshù hěn fùzá, mùqián duōbàn háishì zhǐ néng kào réngōng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: The technique of carving jade is very complex; at present, most of it can still only be handled by hand.

examples.chinese: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng méiyǒu zhǔrén de fángwū chōngmǎn kǒngbù de chuánshuō, yībān rén dōu bù yuànyì kàojìn.
examples.english: That house without an owner is full of terrifying legends; ordinary people are all unwilling to go near it.

items.wordHook: A 告(tell) leans on a 非(fēi) fence to stay nearby → 靠(nearby).

examples.chinese: 球員的表現讓教練不斷搖頭，並表示得加強平常的訓練。
examples.pinyin: Qiúyuán de biǎoxiàn ràng jiàoliàn bùduàn yáotóu, bìng biǎoshì děi jiāqiáng píngcháng de xùnliàn.
examples.english: The players' performance made the coach constantly shake his head, and he indicated that they need to strengthen their regular training.

examples.chinese: 你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng cānjiā zhè xiàng chángpǎo bǐsài de huà, kěyǐ dào wǎngzhàn bàomíng, dēngjì zhīhòu huì yǒu rén gēn nǐ liánluò.
examples.english: If you want to participate in this long-distance race, you can sign up on the website; after you register, someone will contact you.

examples.chinese: 有些女性懷孕時飲食習慣會有極大的改變，醫生說這是正常現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē nǚxìng huáiyùn shí yǐnshí xíguàn huì yǒu jídà de gǎibiàn, yīshēng shuō zhè shì zhèngcháng xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some women experience great changes in their eating habits when they become pregnant; doctors say this is a normal phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 購買任何商品時都應考慮功能以及價格。
examples.pinyin: Gòumǎi rènhé shāngpǐn shí dōu yīng kǎolǜ gōngnéng yǐjí jiàgé.
examples.english: When purchasing any product, one should consider its functions as well as its price.

examples.chinese: 對顧客來說，品牌代表了對公司服務的印象以及商品的品質。
examples.pinyin: Duì gùkè lái shuō, pǐnpái dàibiǎo le duì gōngsī fúwù de yìnxiàng yǐjí shāngpǐn de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: For customers, a brand represents the impression of the company's service as well as the quality of the product.

examples.chinese: 說實話，文憑不是最重要的，重要的是個人的知識與才能。
examples.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wénpíng bù shì zuì zhòngyào de, zhòngyào de shì gèrén de zhīshì yǔ cáinéng.
examples.english: To be honest, a diploma is not the most important thing; what is important is a person's knowledge and ability.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

examples.chinese: 出國旅行最好辦個保險，發生意外時才能獲得保障。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó lǚxíng zuìhǎo bàn ge bǎoxiǎn, fāshēng yìwài shí cái néng huòdé bǎozhàng.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, it is best to get insurance; only then can you obtain protection when an accident occurs.

items.wordHook: 做(make) + 飯(meal) → make a meal, so 做飯 means "to cook."
Combining 協(assist) and 助(help): 協助 means assist.
厽(stacked mounds) rest above a 人(person) brushing 彡(hair) → ready to 參(take part in).
Stepping 回(measure word for time) into or toward 想(think): 回想 means recall.
A curved bowl with three drops inside pulses like a beating 心(heart).
Combining 掌(in charge) and 握(grasp): 掌握 means grasp, to master.
To 教(education) a 導(direct): 教導 means guide, to teach.
晚飯 means dinner: 晚(evening) + 飯(meal) → the evening meal.
Sturdy planks of timber from a seasoned 木(tree) are crafted into a locked storage 匱(cabinet).
Combining 相(mutual) and 反(reverse): 相反 means opposite, contrary.
Combining 突(sudden) and 然(certainly): 突然 means suddenly.
Mastering skills in 老(old) within the 家(family): 老家 means hometown.
廿(Twenty) 一(one) rows across a 田(field), the 八(eight) sheaves ripe → all 黃(yellow).
